entities.name: Alphabet Table T1 – Business Performance KPIs by Year

properties.key_insight: Alphabet's returns and margins are projected to remain robust, with Free Cash Flow recovering strongly after a dip in 2025E.

entities.name: Alphabet Table T2 – Quality of Earnings Metrics
entities.description: Shows Alphabet's cash realization, asset replacement, tax rate, and net debt/equity 2023A-2027E.

properties.key_insight: Alphabet's quality of earnings remains strong, with net debt-to-equity set to turn substantially negative by 2027E.

entities.name: Alphabet Table T3 – Income Statement
entities.description: Covers Alphabet's annual sales, gross profit, EBITDA, net income, and growth rates.

properties.key_insight: Alphabet's sales and profits are forecast to grow at double-digit rates through 2027E, supporting strong earnings growth.

entities.name: Alphabet Table T4 – Free Cash Flow Data
entities.brief: FCF bridge: NI, capex, working capital, 2023A-2027E.

properties.key_insight: Alphabet's free cash flow is projected to rebound in 2026E after a dip in 2025E, supported by rising NI and D&A.

entities.name: Alphabet Table T5 – Balance Sheet Data
entities.description: Details Alphabet's yearly evolution of assets, liabilities, and equity.

properties.key_insight: Total Assets and Cash are projected to increase significantly by 2027E, with no short-term debt.
